note: Bark pools by NPC role (npcs.json 'role'). A bark kind an NPC's own dialogue file lacks is taken from its role pool, then from 'default'. 'asleep' is what a sleeping NPC mumbles when someone talks to them (the talk does not open). Lines keep to short sentences for the voice.

info: Keep to the road after dark.
The town grows by the day.
Stone and sticks fetch fair coin.
asleep: The shop is shut... come back at dawn.

info: Stay near the lights at night.
Wolves are said to roam the far hills.
asleep: Hm? Not on watch... yawn... later.
